text.en:
Asha opened her lunch box. There was rice, dal, a carrot, and a banana.
"Amma, why do you always put so many different things in?" she asked.
Amma said, "Each food helps your body in a different way. Let's find out how."

Food gives us energy to play and grow.
Cereals like rice, wheat and ragi give us energy.
Dal and pulses, milk and eggs help us grow strong.
Fruits and vegetables keep us healthy and help us fight illness.
We should eat a variety of food and drink clean water. Too many sweets or fried snacks are not good for us.
Rice, chapati and ragi give us energy to run and play.
Dal, milk and eggs help our bodies grow strong.
Fruits and vegetables help us stay healthy.
Eat many kinds of food. Sweets and fried snacks only a little.

problem.en: Sort these into foods that give energy and foods that keep us healthy: rice, banana, chapati, carrot.

text.en: Rice and chapati are cereals. They give us energy.
Banana and carrot are fruit and vegetable. They keep us healthy.

why.en: Fruits and vegetables keep us healthy.

text.en: A good lunch box has both kinds.

prompt.en: Your friend only wants to eat chips and sweets. What will you tell your friend?

requiredIdeas.en: Different foods help the body in different ways.
We should eat fruits, vegetables, dal and cereals, and little sweet or fried food.

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking one kind of food is enough.

points.en: Cereals give energy. Dal, milk and eggs help us grow. Fruits and vegetables keep us healthy.
Sweets and fried snacks only a little.
